name: Mauritania
famous_for: Ancient desert caravan library town of Chinguetti, Richat Structure ('Eye of the Sahara'), and the iron ore desert train.
tourists: Approx. 15,000 heritage explorers; famous for Chinguetti ancient Quranic manuscripts and Banc d'Arguin migratory birds.
must_know: The iron ore train running from Zouérat to Nouadhibou is one of the longest and heaviest trains in the world, stretching over 2.5 kilometers.
fun_fact: The Richat Structure in western Mauritania is a prominent 40-kilometer circular geological dome visible from space.
